in_urdu.name: Nuraa
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Light, Glow, Radiance
in_urdu.long_meaning: Nuraa ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ Derived from the Arabic root 'n-r-' meaning 'light'. In Islam, Nuraa signifies the light that guides and protects believers. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) is reported to have said, 'The light of my eyes is my daughter Fatima and the light of my house is my wife Aisha'. Thus, Nuraa can symbolize the light and guidance provided by one's loved ones and the faith.
